{"run_label": "CO2_8stage_pump8_final", "assumptions": "Model of Case 2 CO2 compression/drying train ONLY. No pages other than 96 available - page 96 is only a BFD with no stream tables, pressures, duties or design data. All design choices are independent assumptions, not tuned to withheld publication:

Feeds: Boundary streams as given: Stream18 30C 2.0 bara 69097 kg/h x_CO2 0.9835 x_H2O 0.0165; Stream19 49C 1.4 bara 125180 kg/h x_CO2 0.9728 x_H2O 0.0270 x_H2 0.0002. STREAM18 throttled in VALVE18 to 1.4 bara to enable mixing at lowest pressure, then MIX_OUT.

Thermodynamic: Peng-Robinson (PR) for CO2/H2O/H2 high-pressure system. Suitable for compressors and phase splits; not Steam Tables because CO2/H2 mixture.

Compression train philosophy: Published design stated eight-stage. Final product must be dense-phase pipeline CO2. Assumed final outlet CO2_PRODUCT = 35C, 150 bar absolute (15,000 kPa, ~2175 psia). This is standard US NETL Case B12B-type assumption for CO2 to pipeline/EOR (~152.7 bara). Not from withheld page - explicitly assumed because product conditions are withheld. Therefore explained as assumption, not validation.

Stage pressure ratios: No stage pressures given. Assumed equal ratio per stage for minimum work: overall ratio = 150/1.4 =107.14, 8 steps => per-stage ratio =107.14^(1/8)=1.793. Stages 1-5: 1.4->2.51->4.50->8.07->14.47->25.95 bara (vapor compression). TEG assumed here. Stages 6-7: 25.95->46.53->83.44 bara vapor. After stage7 cooling to 35C at 83.44 bara CO2 is at/beyond critical point (73.8 bara, 31.1C) and becomes dense-phase/supercritical liquid - DWSIM correctly reports V7 ~0 and KO7 = ~192001 kg/h liquid-like. Therefore stage 8 cannot be gas compressor: modeled as PUMP8 dense-phase pump 83.44->150 bara dP=66.56 bar. This still counts as 8 pressure-elevation steps as in eight-stage integrally-geared compressor + pump concept common in NETL studies.

Intercooling/knockout: Each compression followed by cooler to T_out=35C - assumed cooling water/air cooling achieving 35C. Flash drums KO1-KO7 model interstage knockout removing condensed water + co-condensed CO2. No pressure drop assumed in coolers/piping (withheld).

Efficiencies: Each compressor eff_pct=75% isentropic. Typical for multistage integrally-geared CO2 compressor (70-80%). Pump eff_pct=75% as default. Compressor duties reported are shaft/isentroic-corrected thermodynamic work; electrical motor inefficiency not added - if 95% driver, electrical ~1.05x higher.

Dehydration: Approximate TEG dehydration with component_separator because DWSIM has no rigorous TEG/contactor. Placed after stage5 at ~26 bara - industry standard TEG operates 25-40 bara before deep compression to avoid hydrate/free water. Recover_pct: CO2 99.8% to product (0.2% slip to TEG vent), H2 99.8% to product, H2O 0.5% to product => 99.5% water removed. Gives dry CO2 <10 ppmw water. TEG_REJECT = 609 kg/h containing 224 kg/h water + 385 kg/h co-absorbed CO2. Not a design model, fixed-split approximation only.

Final aftercooling: COOL8 cools pumped dense-phase from pump discharge ~53.8C (pump heating) to 35C pipeline temperature, duty ~3.02 MW cooling.

All T_out_C, P_out_bar, recoveries and efficiencies are assumptions with rationale above, not independent validation against publication.", "limitations": "No validation possible against withheld Table 3-7/Case 2 stream table. Results are purely consequence of assumed 150 bara/35C pipeline target, equal ratio 1.793, 75% efficiencies and TEG split. Different pipeline spec (e.g. 110 bara, 30C, 40C) would change power ~10-15% and shift dense-phase boundary. PR package: CO2-H2O mutual solubility and water content at >73 bara has uncertainty vs specialized EOS (SPUNG, etc.); knockout amounts approximate. Coolers assumed no dP and perfect 35C control - real pressure losses 0.1-0.3 bar/stage would increase power. Mixer assumes adiabatic; real piping heat loss not modeled. component_separator is fixed split, not rigorous TEG - does not model TEG circulation, reboiler duty, BTEX, nor water dewpoint to -40C. Pump inlet is supercritical/dense-phase - DWSIM pump reports 0 m3/h due to near-critical property interpolation; duty is small but sensitive to density model. No impurities beyond CO2/H2O/H2 - real Cansolv/MDEA slip (N2,O2,SOx,amines) not included. Interstage water KO streams not routed to treatment-disposition shown only as KO1-5 liquid outlets. Motor, gearbox, seal leakage, and cooling-water system power not included. Scale not validated for turndown, NPSH, or control."}

Results are purely consequence of assumed 150 bara/35C pipeline target, equal ratio 1.793, 75% efficiencies and TEG split. Different pipeline spec (e.g. 110 bara, 30C, 40C) would change power ~10-15% and shift dense-phase boundary.
